text.text_excerpt: Great environment with good music! I went during the day, so I don't know what it is like at night. The bartender was very friendly. I had a watermelon mojito - great drink!! Very refreshing with chunks of fresh watermelon in it. Would come back!

Nothing fancy goin on here but the people are super nice. It's very relaxing and when the town is crazy and you need a bit of a slower pace. In addition to that...finding a bathroom in the French quarter is somewhat of a witch hunt so yet another reason I like it here. Have some drinks and let it flowww. They have a nice patio in the back which is often where I sit or a full bar, couches, tables and chairs inside. They have a stage although it's been ages since I have come in the evenings when they likely utilize it. So unsure if entertainment is still a thing these days. It's more of an afternoon stop for me. 5 stars for being a local pub with out the fuss.

Great cheap drinks and friendly staff. A little off the beaten path on Rampart between St. Ann and Dumaine. The decoration is a little eclectic in an unremarkable way, but the prices and the staff make up for it. If you're looking for a fun good time, try the 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 pm shift, Wilhemina (a guy despite the name) is hysterical and sure to make you laugh whether it's by talking to you or going off on some schmuck. I recommend you give it a try, most people stay for the friendly conversation.
